name: multicloud
description: Multicloud's customer-facing skills: point your own agent at your cluster and your cloud accounts, and keep the credentials on your machine.

metadata.description: Customer-facing skills for the Multicloud platform. Names reserved for the rest of the shelf are listed in README.md.

plugins.name: multicloud-advisor
plugins.description: Install the Multicloud Advisor into a Kubernetes cluster and connect to it over MCP, so your agent can price what you run today against every major cloud's spot and on-demand markets.

plugins.name: multicloud-connect-aws
plugins.description: Connect your AWS account to Multicloud: your agent runs mctl and OpenTofu/Terraform with your own AWS login, asks before it applies, and reports Ready or the missing permissions. It never sees your API key or the connect code.
